verification_note: The pinned image links lxml.etree to source-built libxml2 2.15.4. Its first valid namespace control covers 1,463 lines in libxml2 parser.c; the second valid control matches its exact expected tree. The AFL++ bridge maps executed parser.c lines, with five identical control runs yielding identical feedback and the second control changing 213 parser lines and 209 AFL++ tuple IDs. Lines 8700–8720 of parser.c are excluded from AFL++ feedback because an address-sensitive attribute lookup varied across identical replays; they remain in the source coverage report. The two controls do not establish DTD, external entity, non-UTF-8, or XML 1.1 behavior.
